facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2023-0247 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 20 December 2023 as a scheduled change under change assurance; no event precedes it in the record. The change assurance record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to restate an existing duty without altering what it requires. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the material unwanted event control set is preserved.
